source_title: Peloton Launches Peloton Broker to Streamline Early-Stage Land Acquisition for Energy Projects - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
New tract-based pre-leasing tool joins the Land Data Management solution in the Peloton Platform
CALGARY, AB , Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Peloton, a provider of energy data management software, today announced the launch of Peloton Broker, a tract-based pre-leasing management tool built for energy projects. Peloton Broker gives brokers, consultants, land departments, and legal teams one place to handle ownership discovery, negotiation tracking, and title curative work, so they can move from prospect to signed lease without re-entering data or juggling separate systems.
Peloton Broker is part of Peloton's Land Data Management solution in the Peloton Platform, alongside LandView, LandView Map, and Peloton Dashboards. It extends Peloton's trusted foundation to the earliest stage of land acquisition, with pre-leasing work carrying straight into agreement-based lease management in LandView.
"The pre-leasing stage has always been where land data is most scattered, with ownership research in one place, negotiation notes in another, and title issues surfacing late," said James Hatcher, Product Manager â Land Data Management at Peloton. "Peloton Broker brings that work into the Peloton Platform from day one, so land teams start every lease with a complete picture and the rest of the organization gets land data it can trust."
Built for the start of the lease lifecycle
Peloton Broker helps land teams at oil and gas operators and renewable energy developers:
Track ownership at the tract level, covering both surface and mineral rights
Manage negotiations in integrated workflows that record every offer, contact, and status change
Catch title concerns early with title curative support, before they hold up execution
Work from the map with GIS-driven prospect management connected to LandView Map
Keep audit-ready records with full traceability from first contact to executed lease
The Peloton Platform is a SaaS solution hosted by Microsoft Azure that brings well, production, and land data together in one environment. With Peloton Broker on the platform, customers get:
A single source of truth. Land, operations, and finance teams work from the same accurate, up-to-date information, with master data such as business associates, wells, and units shared across products.
Linked lifecycles. Land data ties into well and production data in WellView and ProdView, and integrates with third-party ERP and financial systems.
Enterprise-grade security, backed by Peloton's SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type 2 certifications.
Peloton Broker is available now. To learn more, visit peloton.com/products/land-data-management/broker .
Headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, and founded in 1991, Peloton created the energy industry's original data management solution, and it remains the standard today. With more than three decades of industry expertise and over 700 clients globally, Peloton offers software across the well, production, and land lifecycles. The Peloton Platform brings all three together in one integrated SaaS environment, hosted by Microsoft Azure.
